keyEvents.text: Goal! Middlesbrough 1, Swansea City 0. Myles Peart-Harris (Middlesbrough) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Neto Borges.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Will Lankshear (Middlesbrough) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Middlesbrough 1, Swansea City 1. Joseph Opoku (Swansea City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a set piece situation.
Callum Brittain (Middlesbrough) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Stephen Eustaquio (Swansea City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Middlesbrough 1, Swansea City 1.
Goal! Middlesbrough 2, Swansea City 1. Will Lankshear (Middlesbrough) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Myles Peart-Harris.
Substitution, Swansea City. Ross Stewart replaces Eom Ji-Sung.
Substitution, Swansea City. Jay Fulton replaces Stephen Eustaquio.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Sebastian Berhalter replaces David Strelec.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Tommy Conway replaces Will Lankshear.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Max Arfsten replaces Amario Cozier-Duberry.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Kyle Joseph replaces Myles Peart-Harris.
Substitution, Swansea City. Tom Iorpenda replaces Elijah Just.
Substitution, Swansea City. Zan Vipotnik replaces Melker Widell.
Adam Idah (Swansea City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Luke Ayling replaces Riley McGree.
